## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ConfigureAsgardeoAsAnExterna`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `asgardeo`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ConfigureAsgardeoAsAnExterna**.

## Step 2: Add Asgardeo as an external IdP

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to [WSO2 Cloud](https://console.devant.dev/). -->
2. <!-- manual: In the top navigation, click your Organization. -->
3. In the left navigation menu under **Admin**, select **Settings**.
4. Select **Application Security** tab and then click the **Identity Providers**.
5. Select **+ Identity Provider**.
6. Select **Asgardeo**.
7. <!-- manual: In the dialog that opens, enter a name and a description for the IdP. -->
8. <!-- manual: In the Well-Known URL field, paste the discovery endpoint URL you copied from your Asgardeo application. -->
9. <!-- manual: Leave the Apply to all environments checkbox selected. This allows tokens generated via this IdP to invoke APIs across all environments. :::note To restrict token use to specific environments, clear the Apply to all environments checkbox and select the required environments from the Environments list. ::: -->
10. Select **Next**. The server endpoints are displayed. You can use these to implement and configure authentication for your application.
11. <!-- manual: configure authentication for your application -->
12. Select **Add**.
